en.headline: Government aims to complete heat-stress warning system review by end of August
en.dek: Labour and welfare chief Chris Sun said the Labour Department and Observatory are working to adjust thresholds after the lowest-level alert stayed in force during record temperatures.
body: The government aims to finalise changes to Hong Kong’s Heat Stress at Work Warning system by the end of this month, Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun Yuk-han said on Tuesday.

Sun said the Labour Department and the Hong Kong Observatory would complete preparatory work on activation thresholds and triggering mechanisms so any adjustments could be put into practice promptly. He noted that the system must address challenges posed by climate change.

The three-tier amber-red-black warning, based on the Hong Kong Heat Index, drew criticism after remaining at the lowest level during recent extreme heat, including a record 36.9 degrees Celsius recorded on 9 August. The Labour Department has said it will optimise the mechanism following comments from former Observatory officials.

zh.headline: 政府料本月底前完成酷熱工作警告機制檢討
zh.dek: 勞福局局長孫玉菡表示，勞工處與天文台正就啟動門檻及觸發機制進行準備工作，以盡快落實優化。
body: 勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡周二表示，政府目標於本月底前完成香港酷熱工作警告機制的檢討及優化。
孫玉菡指，勞工處與香港天文台會就系統啟動門檻及觸發安排完成準備工作，以便盡快作出調整並付諸實行。他強調機制須應對氣候變化帶來的挑戰。
現行以香港暑熱指數為基礎的三級（黃、紅、黑）警告機制，早前在錄得破紀錄高溫期間仍維持最低級別，包括8月9日錄得36.9度，引發前天文台人員批評。勞工處已表示會優化有關機制。
